behaviors: Task 1 owns exactly service.py, wire.py, and test_engine_v2_service.py. It creates no HTTP API, composite app, SDK, CLI, P0 adapter integration, documentation, fixture, database, migration, schema, ML, model, dataset, or source-research artifact.

Division 23 v2 compiler, formulas, evaluator, and EngineStore are an environmental prerequisite frozen at base commit f59e0f5105bd016aed97a5d00b2fe275b4da4dd1 and integrated tree 6a81b7a0de2e483f9642c3dd446111cf620ea441. Graph manifests are intra-manifest only, so no cross-graph sibling node is invented.

Read-only sibling inputs are tests/fixtures/engine_v2/full_division23_calculation_pack.json and tests/fixtures/engine_v2/airside_equipment_bundle.json. The owned test JSON-loads them, replaces only bundle pack_sha256 with compiled.sha256, and calls compile_observation_bundle(bundle_document, pack=compiled). A blocked case deep-copies the bundle and removes LENGTH; it does not add, rewrite, or duplicate a fixture or core contract.

EngineV2Service delegates compile, import, and digest-selected load to accepted sibling interfaces. EngineV2Service.evaluate must execute loaded_pack = self._store.load_pack(pack_sha256=bundle.pack_sha256) and then return evaluate_bundle(loaded_pack, bundle); an unimported digest propagates helios_takeoff_core.errors.NotFoundError. It exposes no latest-pack selection, activation, model, source-fetch, P0 lookup, quantity authority, pricing, estimate, approval, bid, project, or drawing behavior.

observation_bundle_document is a strict compiler-input projection for BENCHMARK only. It emits exactly protocol, mode, pack_sha256, subject_code, context, observations, and benchmark_artifact_sha256; it round-trips through compile_observation_bundle(document, pack=compiled), omits project/evidence/internal digest fields, and rejects PROJECT_BOUND fail-closed.

engine_result_set_document recursively materializes EngineResultSet. wire_document handles dataclasses, general Enum, Mapping with string keys, tuple/list, None, str, int, and bool while rejecting float, bytes, Path, non-string mapping keys, and unknown objects. It must process a general Enum before primitive str/int/bool checks and recursively emit the member's plain .value through the same strict dispatcher; a recursively unsupported enum value is rejected. HTTP canonical-byte sorting remains outside Task 1.

The only actual transport available for this task is EXTERNAL_SESSION. An immutable builder EXTERNAL_SESSION assignment is required before implementation. A distinct reviewer EXTERNAL_SESSION assignment is required only after the task is RETURNED and before review begins, because Build Fabric permits reviewer assignment only at that lifecycle boundary. This manifest claims no provider, session ID, LOCAL_ADAPTER capability or availability, local preflight, executable, target-host, installed-code, or production-self-use result.
There is no ML, dataset, Hugging Face, artifact, benchmark, provider-runtime, target-host, source-record, or source-packet dependency. ML unavailability cannot block this Task 1 service/wire slice.

The plan's RED and GREEN command is frozen through the equivalent Build Fabric argv /usr/bin/env PYTHONPATH=../src:.. python3 -m unittest tests.test_engine_v2_service -v from cwd=tools, because task-manifest repository paths reject cwd=. . RED is captured once before service.py and wire.py exist; GREEN passes once after the owned implementation. No unchanged retry or full-suite command is authorized.

capability: Expose accepted Division 23 v2 compilation, EngineStore, and evaluation through one bounded application service and deterministic wire serializer without HTTP, SDK, CLI, P0, ML, or kernel authority.

block.action: Block the task, preserve the exact prerequisite mismatch, and create a successor only after the sibling interface is reconciled; do not edit or duplicate the sibling kernel.
block.when: The base commit/tree lacks frozen v2 interfaces, compile_observation_bundle lacks pack=compiled, or a required read-only fixture is absent or changed.

block.action: Block implementation until an immutable builder EXTERNAL_SESSION assignment is recorded; do not substitute a local adapter, unrecorded session, provider, or fabricated receipt.
block.when: No preassigned external-session builder assignment is verified before Task 1 implementation starts.

block.action: Block review until an immutable reviewer EXTERNAL_SESSION assignment distinct from the builder is recorded after the task is RETURNED and before review begins; do not preassign it during implementation or fabricate a receipt.
block.when: No distinct external-session reviewer assignment is verified at the Build Fabric RETURNED-to-review boundary.

escalation.action: Escalate to a bounded successor or split the service/wire seam after recording the concrete failure; do not rerun an unchanged command or take a third substantive correction round.
escalation.when: The focused or affected gate remains failing after two substantive correction rounds.

reroute.action: Create a replacement immutable EXTERNAL_SESSION assignment only at the applicable lifecycle boundary: builder before implementation or distinct reviewer after RETURNED and before review. Preserve unavailable-assignment evidence; no local-adapter or target-host claim is created.
reroute.when: The assigned external-session builder or reviewer becomes unavailable before completing its bounded role.

stop.when: The patch changes a forbidden sibling kernel, p0_adapter, Task 2-5 path, P0/P1A/v1 authority surface, fixture, build-control policy, ML surface, quantity, pricing, estimate, approval, bid, model, source, or provider-runtime behavior.
